name: socialcredit
title: Social Credit
blurb: a Bluesky reputation leaderboard, separate from likes and reposts: sign in with Bluesky OAuth, paste any handle, give them +1 or -1 (or just reply "socialcredit +1"/"-1"). scores, the one-vote-per-person-per-hour cooldown, and the no-self-voting rule are tallied live in your browser off Jetstream — no backend, so a fresh session only sees a couple days back. built for @fromthewestmeadow.com.
